title: AI-300: Optimizing Generative AI Systems and Model Performance

objectives.text: Optimize retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) performance and accuracy

children.text: Optimize retrieval performance by tuning similarity thresholds, chunk sizes, and retrieval strategies
Select and fine-tune embedding models for domain-specific use cases and accuracy improvements
Implement and optimize hybrid search approaches combining semantic and keyword-based retrieval
Evaluate and improve RAG system performance by using relevance metrics and A/B testing frameworks

objectives.text: Implement advanced fine-tuning and model customization

children.text: Design and implement advanced fine-tuning methods
Create and manage synthetic data for fine-tuning
Monitor and optimize fine-tuned model performance
Manage a fine-tuned model from development through production deployment

demos.title: Demo: Tune chunk sizes and similarity cutoffs on Azure AI Search results

steps.title: Query one Azure AI Search Free-tier index with a chunk_size pre-filter to select 64-, 128-, or 192-token chunks of the same corpus, encoded with all-MiniLM-L6-v2
Vary vector candidate depth, convert single-vector query scores back to cosine similarity in the Python client, and apply a cutoff; inspect retained and rejected results
Compare Recall@k, boundary failures, and latency while changing one control at a time; keep the configuration with the best recall within the latency budget

expected_evidence: Chunk-size-controlled Azure search responses
Retained and rejected single-vector candidates with converted cosine values
Recall@k, boundary-failure and latency comparison

demos.title: Demo: Run hybrid search and semantic reranking in Azure

steps.title: Send text and vector queries together to Azure AI Search; compare its reciprocal rank fusion results with separate keyword and vector searches
Vary vector weight and candidate depth, then enable semantic reranking with 50 vector candidates and inspect search and reranker scores separately
Compare exact-identifier and paraphrased questions on the same validation set; accept a relevance gain only when no query type regresses

expected_evidence: Keyword, vector and reciprocal-rank-fused result comparisons
Vector-weight, candidate-depth and semantic reranker response fields
Exact-identifier and paraphrase validation results

demos.title: Demo: Evaluate RAG variants with Azure services

steps.title: Run the Python experiment runner against two configurations of the same Azure AI Search index and the same gpt-5.6-luna deployment in Microsoft Foundry, holding the prompt and generation settings fixed
Compare Recall@k, nDCG@k, manually reviewed answer support, and latency; inspect a response against its source and check for regressions
Assign synthetic sessions consistently to A or B, log exposures and outcomes to Azure ML with MLflow, and check the primary metric, declared before the run, against its stop rule

expected_evidence: Assignments to fixed retrieval variants and matching Foundry generation settings
Recall@k, nDCG@k, manually reviewed answer support, latency, source checks and regression checks

demos.title: Demo: Fine-tune domain embeddings in Azure ML

steps.title: Configure a Sentence Transformers contrastive training script for the selected bge-small-en-v1.5 model with reviewed positive pairs and hard negatives, then submit an Azure ML CPU command job
Inspect the completed job and confirm its code, environment, and data versions; select the checkpoint with the best validation metrics and keep the job output

Encode corpus and queries with the selected checkpoint; populate its dedicated vector field in the same index, filter to the same chunk_size, and keep the tuned field only if its held-out relevance beats both the all-MiniLM-L6-v2 and base bge-small-en-v1.5 fields

expected_evidence: Azure ML CPU job configuration with reviewed positive pairs and hard negatives
Matching completed training job, input versions, validation metrics and selected checkpoint
Checkpoint-aligned corpus/query vectors and held-out baseline comparison

demos.title: Demo: Monitor canary traffic and verify rollback in Azure ML

steps.title: Allocate 90 percent of managed endpoint traffic to the baseline and 10 percent to the candidate; send enough labeled test traffic to meet each gate’s minimum sample size, and record which deployment served each response
Inspect Request Latency P95 split by deployment, Requests Per Minute split by deployment and status-code class, and the prepared Azure Monitor alert rule on Request Latency P95
Check the candidate’s canary responses and serving metrics against the predeclared gates, and stop promotion on any failure
Exercise the rollback path by restoring 100 percent traffic to the baseline, then verify the routed model identity and responses before the promotion decision

expected_evidence: 90/10 routed identities and declared sample counts
Observed deployment/status metrics and prepared normal-threshold alert
Reviewed quality/resource/latency gate decision; no manufactured failure
100/0 restored baseline with routed identity and recovery proof
